answer: A farm of 218 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are published in pulse, queued in willow, and onyx publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 37 identities per epoch. A farm of 2906 identities would post 3415 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
